explanation: If NP = coNP then (SAT, complement of SAT) is a disjoint NP pair, and any disjoint NP pair (A, B) reduces to it via a Karp reduction of A to SAT (which maps A into SAT and the complement of A, hence B, into non-SAT). This is the standard fact underlying Pudlák's remark that DisjNP implies NP ≠ coNP (arXiv:1601.01487). The formal statement is exactly this implication. True. Faithful.
